result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may assign without consent to an Affiliate or transaction successor; Licensor assignments require reasonably withheld consent and are prohibited to Licensee competitors; and Licensee change of control creates no Licensor termination right. The revision remains focused on assignment and change of control and preserves the existing restriction on sublicensing or transferring license rights. It is not minimal, however, because it also adds protections against suspension and repricing, a new post-closing notice obligation, a reasonableness standard for consent to other Licensee assignments, and additional transaction concepts such as reorganizations and equity sales. The drafting is generally professional, though the preexisting missing punctuation before “Subject to the terms” should have been corrected and the void-assignment sentence could more clearly exempt expressly permitted assignments.
